title: Ministry of Finance notifies 16% escalation in National Calamity Contingent Duty (NCCD) on cigarettes and specified tobacco items
content: The Department of Revenue, Ministry of Finance, has issued a notification revising the excise and NCCD schedule on tobacco products by 16% effective immediately.

title: RBI Monetary Policy Committee shifts policy stance from 'Withdrawal of Accommodation' to 'Neutral'; retains Repo Rate at 6.50%
content: The Monetary Policy Committee voted unanimously to revise the monetary policy stance to 'Neutral', signaling flexibility while maintaining vigilance on food inflation.

title: NCLT sanctions scheme of demerger of Tata Motors into two separate listed entities for Commercial and Passenger Vehicles
content: Tata Motors Ltd has received the certified true copy of the order passed by the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Mumbai Bench sanctioning the scheme of arrangement for demerger.

title: Red Sea shipping freight rates jump 45% amid persistent container rerouting around Cape of Good Hope
content: Ocean container carriers report transit delays of 12-14 days and bunker fuel surcharges, impacting Indian merchandise export consignments to Europe.

title: Unverified WhatsApp and Telegram rumors claim SEBI to ban all algo-based automated trading for retail accounts
content: Speculation circulating in retail trading circles claims regulator will impose blanket ban on APIs used by retail trading algorithms.
